_comment: Category-based task routing system - inspired by oh-my-opencode's ulw pattern

product-planning._description: 战略产品规划、愿景定义、路线图制定
product-planning.promptAppend: You are defining product vision and strategic direction. Focus on business value, user needs, and market positioning.

requirements-analysis._description: 需求收集、用户故事定义、业务分析
requirements-analysis.promptAppend: You are analyzing business requirements and user needs. Focus on clarity, completeness, and traceability.

spec-writing._description: 撰写详细的产品规格说明文档
spec-writing.promptAppend: You are writing detailed specification documents following OpenSpec methodology. Use SHALL/MUST terminology and define acceptance criteria.

ux-research._description: 用户研究、可用性测试、用户行为分析
ux-research.promptAppend: You are conducting user research and usability analysis. Focus on user pain points, behaviors, and needs.

ux-design._description: UI/UX 设计、交互流程、原型设计
ux-design.promptAppend: You are designing user experiences and interfaces. Be creative, focus on usability, accessibility, and delight.

architecture._description: 系统架构设计、技术决策、模式选择
architecture.promptAppend: You are designing system architecture. Focus on scalability, maintainability, and technical excellence.

code-implementation._description: 功能实现、编码、单元测试
code-implementation.promptAppend: You are implementing features according to specifications. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code.

testing._description: QA 测试、测试策略、质量保证
testing.promptAppend: You are testing software quality. Focus on thoroughness, edge cases, and clear bug reports.

documentation._description: 技术文档编写、API 文档、用户指南
documentation.promptAppend: You are writing technical documentation. Be clear, concise, and audience-appropriate.

research._description: 代码库探索、技术调研、文档查找
research.promptAppend: You are researching codebases and technologies. Be thorough, provide precise references, and cite sources.

project-management._description: 项目管理、时间线跟踪、风险管理
project-management.promptAppend: You are managing project execution. Focus on timelines, resources, risks, and stakeholder communication.
